entities.summary: Ayn-al-Qużāt Hamadānī, also spelled Ain-al Quzat Hamedani or ʿAyn-al Qudat Hamadhani (1098–1131), was a Persian jurist, mystic, philosopher, poet and mathematician who was executed at the age of 33.
